SELECT b.billing_id AS billingId, b.patient_id AS patientId, b.billing_status AS billingStatus,
CASE WHEN b.reception_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'OUTPATIENT' ELSE 'INPATIENT' END AS billingType,
(SELECT NVL(SUM(bd.amount), 0) FROM billing_detail bd WHERE bd.billing_id = b.billing_id AND bd.detail_status = 'READY') AS totalAmount,
TO_CHAR(b.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt
FROM billing b
b.billing_status = 'READY'
AND b.patient_id IN
#{pid}
ORDER BY b.billing_id DESC

SELECT b.billing_id AS billingId, b.patient_id AS patientId, b.reception_id AS receptionId, b.admission_id AS admissionId, b.billing_status AS billingStatus,
bd.quantity AS quantity, bd.unit_price AS unitPrice, bd.amount AS amount, bd.detail_status AS detailStatus, bd.occurred_at AS occurredAt, bd.billing_type AS billingType,
bm.fee_code AS feeCode, bm.fee_name AS itemName,
NVL(SUM(bd.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY b.billing_id), 0) AS totalAmount
FROM billing b
JOIN billing_detail bd ON b.billing_id = bd.billing_id
JOIN billing_master bm ON bd.billing_master_id = bm.billing_master_id
WHERE b.billing_id = #{billingId} AND b.billing_status = 'READY' AND bd.detail_status = 'READY'
ORDER BY bd.occurred_at ASC

SELECT b.billing_id AS billingId, b.patient_id AS patientId, b.reception_id AS receptionId, b.admission_id AS admissionId, b.billing_status AS billingStatus,
bd.quantity AS quantity, bd.unit_price AS unitPrice, bd.amount AS amount, bd.detail_status AS detailStatus, bd.occurred_at AS occurredAt, bd.billing_type AS billingType,
bm.fee_code AS feeCode, bm.fee_name AS itemName,
NVL(SUM(bd.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY b.billing_id), 0) AS totalAmount
FROM billing b
JOIN billing_detail bd ON b.billing_id = bd.billing_id
JOIN billing_master bm ON bd.billing_master_id = bm.billing_master_id
WHERE b.patient_id = #{patientId} AND b.billing_status = 'READY' AND bd.detail_status = 'READY'
ORDER BY bd.occurred_at ASC

SELECT b.billing_id AS billingId, b.billing_status AS billingStatus
FROM billing b
WHERE b.billing_id = #{billingId} AND b.billing_status = 'READY'
